title: Quantum implementation of the unitary coupled cluster for simulating molecular electronic structure
problem_summary: First experimental demonstration of the unitary coupled cluster VQE ansatz on a trapped-ion system, probing the HeH+ ground-state energy surface, studying excited-state energies, and simulating non-perturbative bond dissociation -- notable as a cross-hardware (trapped-ion, vs. photonic in peruzzo2014 and superconducting in omalley2016/kandala2017) reproduction of the same HeH+ problem class.

components.family_or_name: HeH+ ground-state and excited-state energies; bond dissociation
components.notes: Same molecule as the original VQE paper (peruzzo2014), on different hardware -- useful cross-hardware comparison anchor.

workflow_composition_notes: UCC ansatz implemented and variationally optimized on trapped-ion hardware for the same HeH+ problem class as the original photonic VQE demonstration (peruzzo2014), enabling a same-molecule, different-hardware comparison within this corpus.
